explanation: The violation occurred because after BREAK recovery the transmitter momentarily cleared busy (r_busy=0) regardless of CTS status, creating a one-cycle window where a byte could be accepted while the receiver continuously blocked. The fix changes the TXU_BREAK block to set r_busy based on the synchronized CTS (ck_cts) so that when hardware flow control is enabled and the receiver is blocked (ck_cts=0), busy remains high after the 16-baud recovery interval.
